Quartz Geode Halves Lot - 11 Pieces
Dyed Purple Crystalline Mineral Specimens
Decorative Rocks & Crystals
This collection features eleven natural quartz geode halves that have been color-enhanced with a rich violet-purple dye and accented with sparkling golden metallic flecks across their interior crystalline cavities. Each specimen displays a rough, dark natural exterior matrix contrasting with the shimmering druzy crystal pockets inside, making them ideal for display, crystal collections, crafting, or educational study.
Items Included:
11 individual geode halves ranging in size from approximately 2.5 to 5 inches across
Hollowed cavities lined with quartz crystal druse dyed in vibrant purple tones
Glistening gold-tone metallic dusting across interior crystal faces
Natural dark matrix outer rinds with rugged, unpolished rocky surfaces
Condition:
All 11 geode halves are intact with natural rough edges and typical crystalline clefts. Druzy interiors retain rich purple coloration with sparkling metallic accents. Outer rinds show expected natural texture and light stone dust from handling.
